messages.label: Phase 1 (listening_for_discover) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_first_request. Cond: is_dhcp_discover() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac)
Phase 2 (listening_for_first_request) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_renewing_request. Cond: is_dhcp_request() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac)

Phase 3 (listening_for_renewing_request) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_first_rebinding_request. Cond: is_dhcp_request() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac) and dst_ip_equals(expected.server_id_be)

Phase 4 (listening_for_first_rebinding_request) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_second_rebinding_request. Cond: is_dhcp_request() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac) and dst_ip_is_broadcast()
